description: Consommation de Gaz Naturel Carburant (GNC) en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by France Mobilité Biogaz. Ce jeu de données présente les consommations de l'ensemble des stations GNC ( Gaz Naturel Carburant ) raccordées aux réseaux de transport et de distribution en Pays de la Loire. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are LOM, TEO. The portal shows 12 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-02-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
